notes.subject: השרד
notes.rationale: Tok hia i stap long Tanakh long dispela ples tasol (wantaim 39:41) — 'klos ol i wokim wantaim nil'.

notes.subject: השרד
notes.rationale: Ol tanima i no gat wanpela mining: 'ol klos bilong sevis' (KJV) i go long שרת, tasol JPS 'plaited' na ASV 'finely wrought' i holim mining bilong wokim wantaim nil.

notes.subject: pris
notes.rationale: כהן em i man i wok long holi wok; 'pris' long Tok Pisin i klostu olsem.

translation: ⟨את⟩ ol klos bilong wokim wantaim nil, bilong wokim sevis long holi ples, ⟨את⟩ ol holi klos bilong Aharon pris, na ⟨את⟩ ol klos bilong ol pikinini man bilong en, bilong wokim ol i kamap pris.
